category_definition: African Grocery Store: an independent walk-in retail storefront selling African pantry staples (fufu/poundo flour, gari, egusi, ogbono, teff flour, injera, berbere, suya spice, red palm oil, stockfish, bitter leaf, malt drinks), fresh/frozen tropical produce and proteins (yams, plantains, cassava leaves, halal goat/mutton/cow foot), and African health-and-beauty goods. Business model is product-first retail, frequently hybridized with a cooked-food counter, a halal butchery, a remittance/mobile top-up desk (Dahabshil, MoneyGram), direct-import supply chains, or African textiles. Subcategories observed in this market: West African (Nigerian, Ghanaian, Senegalese, Liberian); East African/Habesha (Ethiopian/Eritrean); Somali/East African halal markets with remittance counters; pan-African/Caribbean hybrids; and large international supermarkets with substantial African sections (probable fit only). Restaurants without a retail grocery component (Abyssinia, Axum, Zara Habesha, Barako Somali, Barry's African Restaurant, Lete's Injera and Cafe, The Jollof Buka, Eko African Cuisine) are excluded from the qualifying set.
geographic_classification_notes: inside_city was assigned to all Marion County / Indianapolis addresses across the swept corridors (Lafayette Rd, Georgetown Rd, W 38th St, E 38th St, W Morris St, W Washington St, Rockville Rd, Madison Ave, W 22nd St, N/S High School Rd, Girls School Rd, W 10th St, N Keystone Ave, E Thompson Rd, S Lynhurst Dr). Nhyira International Market (Greenwood, Johnson County) is inside the Indianapolis MSA and classified metro_area. Enerem African Food Store (Huntertown, Allen County — Fort Wayne area) and Blessing International Market (Columbus, Bartholomew County) are outside the Indianapolis MSA and classified outside_market; both are excluded from the qualifying set. Additional thin-footprint category storefronts were enumerated by the geography sweeps and are routed to the EMERGING campaign rather than this competitive benchmark set: Baobab African Market LLC (7031 Michigan Rd), Janjai Redlight Market Inc (3504 Madison Ave), Gomez African Grocery LLC (8912 Saint Peter St), 22nd Street African Grocery (11 W 22nd St — retained here), Grace Variety Store (5230 W 10th St), Victory Super Store African Foods LLC (7460 Rockville Rd), Rachel International Food Market LLC (4351 Lafayette Rd Ste F), Hana Market (4861 W Washington St), Jackieline African Market LLC (6833 Stratton Sq), Batis African Store LLC (3550 N Glen Arm Rd), Joshoua Africa Market Ltd (950 N Pershing Ave), African Food Services LLC (4150 Lafayette Rd Suite H), African Caribbean Market (4251 Lafayette Rd — LLC voluntarily dissolved; unresolved status), Garaya African Market LLC (4150 Lafayette Rd Suite C), Royal African Market LLC (3071 N High School Rd), Heaven African Market (4903 S High School Rd), TETEES African Food Market (4903 S High School Rd Suite A), Rachel African Market LLC (5503 Grassy Bank Dr — residential address), Godbless African Market LLC (3175 Watergate Rd Apt 6 — apartment address).
ownership_exclusion_notes: No national_chain, national_franchise or regional_chain entity was identified in this market. Saraga International Grocery is the only multi-location operator (three Indianapolis-metro locations plus Columbus, OH) and is retained as local_chain. All other qualifying records are single-location independents. Two outside_market records (Enerem African Food Store, Blessing International Market) are excluded from the qualifying set. Three records carry category_fit probable rather than verified and are flagged accordingly (Halal Market / Halalmarket Indiana, Safari Restaurant and Halal Market Inc, American International Market / AIM Mart). One record (TETEES African Food Market) carries identity_confidence low because its address is shared with Heaven African Market and its details rest on a single vertical listing; it is routed to hold.

outreach_recommendation.platform_rationale: Google is the only platform in this market where the gold standard is deep enough to benchmark against (the profile's expected_fields centre on a claimed GBP with a correct "African goods store" primary category, 100+ reviews, and interior/shelf photography), and it is simultaneously where this candidate pool carries its most fixable gaps: 12 of 27 qualifying candidates show canonical-NAP drift across surfaces, 17 lack consolidated published hours, and Arsema G Food Mart demonstrates the headline case — a full Ethiopian grocery filed under "Convenience store". Yelp, Apple Maps and Bing are near-empty for the category (0/27 Yelp, 1/27 Apple, 0/27 Bing), so they cannot lead; Facebook matters only where a storefront already runs it (African Market).

suggested_reasons.proposed_label: Principal-office address splits from the storefront address
suggested_reasons.proposed_definition: The entity's registered principal office (or benefit-program registration) address differs from the operating storefront address. Directories and mirrors ingest the regulatory address and publish a listing at a location that is not the walk-in store, while the storefront address carries only a thin or generic listing. Address-keyed joins then treat one operating business as two weak entities, and a searcher who finds the regulatory address is routed to a non-retail location. Distinct from a rename (the name is stable) and from fractional-unit normalization (both addresses are well-formed) — the failure is the registry-vs-storefront split itself.
expected_vectors: registry-address vs storefront-address cross-join per entity
identity-conflict detection keyed on phone + entity id

exemplar_lead.address: 6667 W Washington St, Unit A, Indianapolis, IN 46241 (registry/SNAP principal office: 2724 W 10th St, Indianapolis, IN 46222)
exemplar_lead.notes: INBiz principal office and SNAP registration sit at 2724 W 10th St while the storefront and current hours are at 6667 W Washington St; MapQuest/YellowPages ingested the 10th St variant. Dreamcast African Market (registry 7125 Georgetown Rd #900) and Batis African Store (registry lists both Camby and Indianapolis) show the same split.

suggested_signals.proposed_label: Hosted storefront is the only web surface
suggested_signals.proposed_definition: The operator's only web surface is a low-cost hosted storefront subdomain (Square Online, UENI, Wix, Shopify), which stays publicly indexed even when the platform category is generic or wrong. The hosted catalog often reveals assortment the platform category hides, but the operator has no owned domain and no corroborating profile.

suggested_signals.proposed_label: Only platform listing is an unclaimed aggregator/mirror profile
suggested_signals.proposed_definition: The storefront's principal platform presence is an auto-generated mirror or an explicitly unclaimed listing ("owner has not completed verification process"), so hours, attributes and review responses are not owner-controlled even though the listing ranks and carries the storefront's review surface.
